rules.ingestText: Rule R_FAC_ASPECT_MIN_13_V: the aspect ratio of each glass panel (class GlassPanel, property hasAspectRatio) must be at least 1.3.
Rule R_FAC_ASPECT_MAX_6_V: the aspect ratio of each glass panel (class GlassPanel, property hasAspectRatio) must not exceed 6.0.

Rule R_FAC_LEVELOFFSET_MAX_001_V: the maximum vertical offset of the vertices of each hexagonal unit (class HexagonalUnit, property hasLevelOffsetM) from the nearest level plane must not exceed 0.01 meters.
rules.note: Applies to HexagonalUnit (floors 2+) only; ground-floor pentagons are GroundFloorUnit. Levels include the parapet 114.275 m. Control since 2026-10-05: hex vertices stay on the levels for every tilt pair, so R3 passes in all variants.

rules.ingestText: Rule R_FAC_VERTEXCOUNT_EQ_3_V: each bottom triangular panel (class BottomTriangularPanel, property hasVertexCount) must have exactly 3 vertices.
Rule R_FAC_PLANARITY_MAX_0005_V: the planarity deviation of each glass panel (class GlassPanel, property hasPlanarityDeviationM) must not exceed 0.005 meters.
rules.note: Driver of V4: any tilt pair other than the baseline -1/+1 warps 14-54 Group B panels (up to 3.6 m). Was marked control on 2026-10-04 from V1 alone; reverted 2026-10-05 after the tilt sweep.

rules.ingestText: Rule R_FAC_WIDTH_MIN_45_V: the width of each glass panel (class GlassPanel, property hasWidthM) must be at least 4.5 meters.
Rule R_FAC_HEIGHT_MAX_120_V: the total height of the facade (class Facade, property hasHeightM) must not exceed 120 meters.
rules.calibration: V1 114.275 m (margin 5%); control — same in every variant

rules.ingestText: Rule R_FAC_HEXGAPS_MAX_0_V: each hexagonal unit (class HexagonalUnit, property hasOutlineGapCount) must have a closed outline, so the number of gaps in its outline must not exceed 0.
rules.note: Either swrlb:greaterThan(?g, 0) or swrlb:notEqual(?g, 0) is acceptable. Rule_Id must stay distinct: ingest MERGEs on Rule_Id, so a collision silently merges two rules.

rules.ingestText: Rule R_FAC_GROUNDGAPS_MAX_0_V: each ground floor unit (class GroundFloorUnit, property hasOutlineGapCount) must have a closed outline, so the number of gaps in its outline must not exceed 0.
rules.note: Either swrlb:greaterThan(?g, 0) or swrlb:notEqual(?g, 0) is acceptable. Rule_Id must stay distinct: ingest MERGEs on Rule_Id, so a collision silently merges two rules.

rules.ingestText: Rule R_FAC_VERTEXCOUNT_EQ_5_V: each ground floor unit (class GroundFloorUnit, property hasVertexCount) is a pentagon with a flat bottom and must have exactly 5 vertices.
rules.note: Ground-floor exception: modules on floor 1 are pentagons.

rules.ingestText: Rule R_FAC_VERTEXCOUNT_EQ_6_V: each hexagonal unit (class HexagonalUnit, property hasVertexCount) must have exactly 6 vertices.

control.reason: hasUpperVertex/hasLowerVertex are ObjectProperty atoms; the evaluator recognizes but does not evaluate them

amendment: Ground-floor modules are pentagons (flat bottom) and form their own class GroundFloorUnit; R3 applies to HexagonalUnit (floors 2+) only. All modules must have closed outlines (R9/R10). Vertex counts: GroundFloorUnit = 5 (R11), HexagonalUnit = 6 (R12). R6 kept as a control rule: panels are planar trimmed surfaces, so it passes in every variant. Model fixed before calibration (ground modules closed in GH). 2026-10-05: R4 (symmetry) removed by owner decision; 11 rules.

removed.ingestText: The symmetry deviation of each hexagonal unit (class HexagonalUnit, property hasSymmetryDeviationM) about its own axis through its top and bottom vertices must not exceed 0.01 meters.
removed.note: Applies to HexagonalUnit (floors 2+) only; ground-floor pentagons are GroundFloorUnit.
removed.reason: Owner decision: symmetry requirement dropped entirely. V1 measurements: all 68 flat units exactly symmetric, all 32 units folded around building corners asymmetric (up to 4.83 m developed) by construction. Number 4 is not reused.

calibration: Owner decision 2026-10-05: thresholds anchored on the V1 baseline with ~8% margin; failing variants are produced by slider choice, never by moving thresholds. Source: 3a-V1-summary.txt run 7.
ingestNote: graphRuleId / graphClass / graphDataProperty are what the LLM pipeline actually wrote to Neo4j (see 3c-ingest.md). Use them in Grasshopper.
